sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Roots Beside the Opening

levels.entry: Reeds grow close to the bridge opening.
The central opening is clear. Most of the stems stand against the banks.
Bare patches upstream are giving up silt while the rooted bank holds.
Clear the driftwood at the opening, keep the rooted margins. The maintainer and landing keeper now have a line they can both care for.
